verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud and deployment platform, and comparable hosting platforms do ship image CDNs, so this story is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions image resizing, image optimization, or an image CDN. The docs cover deployment, networking, scaling, observability and AI agents only, so this applicable capability has no support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resize and optimize images on demand via a built-in image CDN
